specs.Item Highlight: Massive 100 Hours Playback, Dual Mics with AI-ENxTM Technology, BEASTTM Mode, Metallic Finish, and Multipoint Connectivity

features: Massive 100 Hours Playback: Eliminate low-battery anxiety completely with an ultra-long-lasting battery setup. Designed for extended travel, marathon study sessions, and full workweeks, these headphones provide up to 100 hours of continuous wireless audio playback on a single full charge.

40mm Driver with boAt Signature Sound: Enjoy rich, dynamic audio performance powered by custom-tuned 40mm dynamic drivers. Precision-engineered to deliver iconic boAt Signature Sound, they project punchy low-end bass alongside crisp, clear mid-range vocals and detailed highs directly to your ears.

Dual Mics with AI-ENx: Deliver crisp vocal clarity during hands-free phone calls and virtual meetings. A dual-microphone setup powered by smart AI-ENx algorithms actively isolates your spoken voice while filtering out background environmental noise and wind interference.

BEAST Mode (60ms Low Latency): Gain a real-time advantage during mobile gaming and media sessions. Activating ultra-low latency BEAST Mode reduces audio delay down to just 60ms, ensuring sound effects and in-game cues sync seamlessly with the action on your screen.

Metallic Finish: Elevate your personal style with an eye-catching visual design. Crafted with premium metallic accents across the earcups and frame, these headphones offer a sleek, modern aesthetic built to complement your everyday tech lineup.
